description: This file defines the QualysOutputProcessor class, which parses XML files from Qualys vulnerability reports to extract assets and vulnerabilities, and produces a ProcessorResult containing these objects.

classes.name: QualysOutputProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes Qualys XML output files to extract hosts, ports, and vulnerability information, returning a structured result.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Loads an XML file, parses host and vulnerability info, creates asset and vulnerability objects, and returns a ProcessorResult.
